scheme_name: Vishvakarma Durghatana Mrtyu par Antyeshti Evan Anugrah Raashi Bhugataan Yojana
other_conditions: The construction worker must be registered as a beneficiary under Section 12 of the Act
Financial assistance is not provided if death is caused by deliberate suicide, consumption of intoxicating substances, or death due to fighting with each other in violation of law to commit a crime
Benefit is given only on the death of the registered worker, not on the death or accident of family members
benefits_summary: Provides ₹25,000 (normal death) or ₹1,00,000 (accidental death) plus ₹5,000 funeral assistance, and ₹75,000 for permanent disability.
documents_required: scanned copy of the registration certificate
